title: 5e-6: near-duplicate detection + trending
description:
## Parent

sutra/83 (5e PRD: health metrics + similarity system)

## What to build

Near-duplicate detection via clustering of HRR strip vectors at snapshot time. Groups of 3+ structurally near-identical functions form "pattern families" — tracked over time for trending.

- Clustering: agglomerative clustering of strip vectors with cosine similarity threshold >= 0.85, minimum group size 3.
- DB: pattern_families table storing family members and similarity scores.
- Snapshot integration: pattern family computation at snapshot time, family counts stored in snapshots for trending.
- MCP tool: sutra_duplicates(threshold=0.85, min_group=3). Returns pattern families with members, similarity scores, and suggested refactoring targets.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Agglomerative clustering over strip vectors at configurable similarity threshold
- [ ] pattern_families table with family members and scores
- [ ] Computation triggered at snapshot time
- [ ] Pattern family counts included in snapshot data for trending
- [ ] sutra_duplicates MCP tool with threshold and min_group parameters
- [ ] Returns families with member functions, average similarity, file locations

## Blocked by

- sutra/88 (5e-4: HRR encoder)"
